title: GV2: three-tenths-base phase-vector sieve with tighter joint envelopes

claims.statement: For every integer N>=2 and every s in Z/NZ, with n=ceil(log2 N), the ONE GV2 algorithm and exact parameter rule in proof.md, including its finite fallback and both cutoffs, recovers all of s from independent ideal source copies with unconditional probability at least 1-2^-8>2/3. On EVERY branch, including all failures, rejected copies, retries and aborts, its total charged sequential work T is O(2^((43/100)sqrt(n log2 n))). This is the full uniform bit-length envelope for n>=2, with the specified finite branch covering smaller n. All outer constants are absolute and independent of N,s and outcomes. Its exact envelope growth index is 1/2. This bound holds jointly with the other three resources and the clean-only tolerance declaration for the same algorithm/configuration.

For every integer N>=2 and every s in Z/NZ, with n=ceil(log2 N), the ONE GV2 algorithm and exact parameter rule in proof.md, including its finite fallback and both cutoffs, recovers all of s from independent ideal source copies with unconditional probability at least 1-2^-8>2/3. On EVERY branch, including all failures, rejected copies, retries and aborts, its peak classical bits S_C is O(2^((2/7)n^(1/3))). This is the full uniform bit-length envelope for n>=2, with the specified finite branch covering smaller n. All outer constants are absolute and independent of N,s and outcomes. Its exact envelope growth index is 1/3. This bound holds jointly with the other three resources and the clean-only tolerance declaration for the same algorithm/configuration.

For every integer N>=2 and every s in Z/NZ, with n=ceil(log2 N), the ONE GV2 algorithm and exact parameter rule in proof.md, including its finite fallback and both cutoffs, recovers all of s from independent ideal source copies with unconditional probability at least 1-2^-8>2/3. On EVERY branch, including all failures, rejected copies, retries and aborts, its peak qubits S_Q is O(n). This is the full uniform bit-length envelope for n>=2, with the specified finite branch covering smaller n. All outer constants are absolute and independent of N,s and outcomes. Its exact envelope growth index is 0/1. This bound holds jointly with the other three resources and the clean-only tolerance declaration for the same algorithm/configuration.

For every integer N>=2 and every s in Z/NZ, with n=ceil(log2 N), the ONE GV2 algorithm and exact parameter rule in proof.md, including its finite fallback and both cutoffs, recovers all of s from independent ideal source copies with unconditional probability at least 1-2^-8>2/3. On EVERY branch, including all failures, rejected copies, retries and aborts, its total acquired source copies Q including discarded and failed copies is O(2^((3/10)sqrt(n log2 n))). This is the full uniform bit-length envelope for n>=2, with the specified finite branch covering smaller n. All outer constants are absolute and independent of N,s and outcomes. Its exact envelope growth index is 1/2. This bound holds jointly with the other three resources and the clean-only tolerance declaration for the same algorithm/configuration.

For the same GV2 algorithm and complete parameter rule in proof.md, the proved malformed-sample fractional guarantee is epsilon(n)=0: all Q acquired source copies are independent ideal coset states. Under this promise, for every N>=2 and every s, unconditional full-secret recovery succeeds with probability at least 1-2^-8>2/3 jointly with all four every-branch resource bounds. No positive corruption tolerance is asserted, and this is not a proof that greater tolerance is impossible.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
